task: Each source has two targets: finite2 with new response parameters, or recurrent with the original response parameters. Both targets share paid prefix controls. Private family labels and seeds appear only in the experiment protocol/results.
source: The first actual published archive supplies author practice. The remaining two published archives supply transfer; their files are loaded only after authoring stops. Preserve the earlier unsuccessful acquisition and its costs separately.
intervention: Revise the previous method on five anonymous practice cases and freeze it for ten cross-source targets. Preserve the four previous cases and their exact settings. Reuse the same refit, record selection, measurement and response operators.
controller: The author selects program edits, paid practice and publication. Each practice and transfer begins with 72 paid controls-only rows, then executes at most 12 declared program steps with 24-row fresh confirmation. All fits and observations share each episode's actual budgets. Transfer uses zero LLM calls; this is LLM-authored method execution, not online LLM selection of each action.
archive_publication: New predictors retain ordinary code, data and binary dependencies. Imported confirmed-model archives accompany them only when declared in the successful finish.reused_files. Runner logs and the undeclared candidate catalog are excluded. An unchanged directly submitted archive keeps its existing dependencies. Revisions to an inherited model publish a new candidate. A latest predictor explicitly depending on an older candidate retains that dependency, which is reported.
failure_policy: Retain all author attempts. Without actual publication skip all ten revised slots and keep reference outcomes. Do not substitute unpublished source.
accounting: Charge new authoring and executed targets once. Prior authoring, supplied paid trace and reused references retain their historical costs without another charge.
terminal_order: Publish using paid practice and fresh confirmation only. Freeze the method before loading transfer archives. Complete all transfer research before terminal scoring; no terminal outcome affects publication or target admission.
scope: Two existing archives under five conditions. The new condition distinguishes obsolete response evidence from inadequate finite-history prediction after a recurrent instrument change. This is development within existing apparatus families.
model_identity: gpt-6-luna is requested through the existing subscription provider. Usage metadata repeating that name does not independently establish server routing.
calibration_change: The fourth and fifth cases share the same initial finite-history instrument, changed response, paid prefix and public 96-row checkpoint. After the checkpoint the fourth changes response parameters; the fifth changes the instrument from finite history to recurrent state, retaining its numerical parameters and response. All subsequent complete trajectories use the settled apparatus.
learning: Start from the exact last published method and its actual paid case_3 trace. Preserve its working branches. The author chooses edits, evidence scope and practice. Only research source and lesson transfer, not practice observations or fitted models.
publication: All five current-source cases must confirm with prior reuse and revision. After a validated refit fails fresh confirmation, demonstrate zero-meter recovery using a separately validated refit of current records; in a different case demonstrate measured instrument/response repair and fresh confirmation.
author_guidance: The last action rewrote the research source; this version has not been practiced. Submit the current shared/consolidated_method.py using finish now to obtain paid practice feedback. If publication fails, revise from that feedback and submit the revised source for practice. The current source and previous paid trials are already restored.
transfer: Freeze the published source for ten registered cross-source targets. Compare the previous published source and developer controller at identical episode limits. Reuse their sixteen unchanged target outcomes; acquire only the new structural-change reference episodes. No reference outcomes enter author context. Transfer uses zero LLM calls.

continue_author.scope: Preserve actual source and paid trials. Unknown usage remains unknown; remaining token allowance subtracts reported usage only. Completed reference episodes are reused by the evaluator and excluded from author context; no reference acquisition is repeated.
continue_author.author_guidance: The last action rewrote the research source; this version has not been practiced. Submit the current shared/consolidated_method.py using finish now to obtain paid practice feedback. If publication fails, revise from that feedback and submit the revised source for practice. The current source and previous paid trials are already restored.
